name: @bithyte/mcp-firewall-console
stderr:
Usage: mcp-firewall-console [options] [command]

MCP Firewall admin console and per-machine host service

Options:
  -v, --version                   output the version number
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  pair [options]                  validate and store the daemon URL and admin
                                  token
  start [options]                 serve the admin UI and proxy to the paired
                                  daemon
  adopt [options] [clients...]
  unadopt [options] [clients...]
  service
  help [command]                  display help for command
